newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to adopt Singapore forex system.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to adopt Singapore forex system.

text.p: Bank of Thailand assistant governor Siri Ganjarerndee said on Thursday Thailand will use the Singapore foreign exchange regime as a model for a revamped baht exchange rate system currently under study by the government.
"We will follow the current foreign exchange system in Singapore in developing our new foreign exchange regime," Siri told reporters.
"(Thailand's) financial liberalisation will continue but that doesn't require the baht to be traded offshore," he said.
Siri said Singapore has succeeded in becoming a regional financial hub while it controls offshore supply of its currency.

The Bank of Thailand launched baht supply controls in mid-May to strike back at speculators after their latest attack on the embattled currency. It blocked offshore baht supply for foreign speculators.
The central bank said on Wednesday that it would soon formalise currency controls to beat baht predators.
The bank earlier this week also implemented measures aimed at stopping foreigners from repatriating baht funds raised through the stock market.
Analysts had said the measures would impede Thailand's plans to become a financial centre as well as to promote the baht as a regional currency.
